title: Closed contact with a tangentially free perturbation
source: Closed-form two-layer shear system with the mass and stiffness matrices shown in README.md.

quantities.reason: With λ = 1 − 0.01, s = 500 λ². The two uniform layer translations have K = [[s,-s],[-s,s+4]] and M = [[2,1],[1,2]]/6; solving det(K − ω²M) gives the two displayed roots. The stated tolerance covers the documented finite-element contact closure/penetration tolerance and the resulting small stretch perturbation, rather than changing the closed-form reference.
